description: A request, command, query, constructor, read, or valid input enters the focal processing boundary.
The obligation activates when configuration, identity, candidates, validity, applicability, or source choice is resolved.
A requested, planned, or committed domain-state change directly activates the obligation.
A successful read, retrieval, load, bootstrap, or other non-mutating result becomes available.
An actual failure, rejection, thrown exception, or unsuccessful operation activates recovery, cleanup, restoration, or diagnostic behavior.
Start, readiness, completion, shutdown, termination, or another lifecycle transition is the direct event.
Content is rendered, presented, laid out, localized, or traversed by assistive technology.
A user directly clicks, selects, seeks, types, or deliberately opens/inspects an interactive surface.
Internal state is serialized, projected, reported, labeled, exported, transported, or emitted.
A concrete operation-owned resource is created, acquired, staged, initialized, or released.
The same atomic obligation explicitly activates on two distinct event routes that cannot be reduced to one event without losing evidence.
